Resolves #21945

A `Neo.tree.List` now shows a selection made from a record and keeps it through every render. Three pieces. First, `src/tree/List.mjs` overrides `getRecordId()`: every tree renders item ids from the record's key, so `selectionModel.select(record)` now finds its item, while a rendered id still resolves back through `store.get()`. Second, `createItem` hands a selected item to `selectionModel.annotateItem()`, under the condition `list.Base#createItem` uses. Third, `selection.ListModel#select()` takes nothing while the view's `disableSelection` is set. The visible effect: the Portal's learn tree highlights the current page, which on `dev` it never does.

Evidence: L3 (a unit test per arm, red-first per half in a `dev` worktree, plus a drive of the Portal learn page at 1440×900, before on `dev` and after on this branch) → L3 required (AC-5 is the Portal in a browser).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/tree/List.spec.mjs`, "a record selected through the model shows as selected, and stays selected through a render", its first arm: `select(record)` renders `neo-selected`. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same test, the `createItems()` arm: `neo-selected` and `aria-selected: true` on the selected item, neither on the other one. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the same test, the rename arm. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: the same test, the `disableSelection` arm, and "a tree built without selection marks no item, even when its model is handed one": no `neo-selected`, no `aria-selected` and no selection right after the direct call. |
| AC-5 | outside-CI: the Portal learn page, frames below. On `dev`, no tree item is selected on landing on `#/learn/gettingstarted/Workspaces`, nor after a click on the next page. On this branch, `gettingstarted/Workspaces` is selected with `aria-selected="true"` on landing, and the click moves the selection to `gettingstarted/DescribingTheUI`. No page errors either way. |
| AC-6 | CI-covered: the unit suite. Locally at 4b106e41d4, the tree, list and selection specs pass 153/153, and the full unit suite 8523 passed, 2 skipped. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The first head switched the tree's `useInternalId` off. That flag also routes a rendered id through `getCanonicalKey()`, which gives `0` for a zero key, dropped as falsy by `getSelectionRecord()`, and `undefined` for a converted key, so `select` events carried a vnode id where the Store record was due (Sophie's review). The tree now overrides `getRecordId()` alone; the reverse lookup stays as on `dev`.
- The `disableSelection` guard sits in `selection.ListModel#select()`, so it holds for a plain list as well: a direct call on a list without selection marks nothing, where before only the next render cleared it.

## Test Evidence

Red-first, per half, in a worktree of `dev`. The new test fails on `dev` at the select arm (line 269). With only `useInternalId: false` applied, it fails at the render arm (line 274). With both halves it passes.

The review's arms, red-first on d9b4d98b0d: the zero key, the converted key and the tree built without selection fail; the plain-key control passes. All four pass at 4b106e41d4. The learn page, driven again at 4b106e41d4: landing selects `gettingstarted/Workspaces`, the click moves the selection to `gettingstarted/DescribingTheUI`, no page errors. The frames below are from the first head and show the same.

The Portal learn page, Neo Dark, 1440×900. Before is `dev` at `74059b3a25`, served from a local `dev` checkout. Its tree, list, selection, data and learn-tree code matches this branch's base; only `src/app/content/Component.mjs` differs, the article renderer.

Before, landing on the page: no item in the tree is selected.

![Before: the learn tree shows no selection](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/bdca16d251892da4c11cf553b6b29a1d5830b39c/review-evidence/21945/before-landing.png?raw=true)

After, landing on the page: its item is selected.

![After: Workspaces and Applications is selected](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/bdca16d251892da4c11cf553b6b29a1d5830b39c/review-evidence/21945/after-landing.png?raw=true)

After a click on "Describing a View": the selection follows.

![After a click: Describing a View is selected](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/bdca16d251892da4c11cf553b6b29a1d5830b39c/review-evidence/21945/after-after-click.png?raw=true)

Frame critique: between the two landing frames only the highlight on "Workspaces and Applications" differs. The highlight is the theme's own selected-item colour; this change adds no style.
